RULES, 2011
PUNJAB PUBLIC PROSECUTION DEPARTMENT (MISCELLANEOUS POSTS) SERVICE RULES,
2011
[Gazette of Punjab, Part I,
18th April, 2012]
No.SOR-III(S&GAD)6-2/2007, dated
14-6-2011.---In exercise of the powers conferred upon him under section 23 of
the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 (VIII of 1974), the Governor of the Punjab
is pleased to make the following rules:---
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) These rules
may be cited as the Punjab Public Prosecution Department (Miscellaneous Posts)
Service Rules, 2011.
(2) These shall come into
force at once.
2. Method of recruitment
etc.---The method of recruitment,
minimum qualification, age limit and other matters related thereto for the
posts shall be as given in the Schedule annexed with these rules.
